title: Pink Dog Halloween Finds
intro: Your dog is coming to the party whether they like it or not, so they may as well match. A pink tulle tutu dress, ghost and pumpkin bandanas, a step-in harness and leash set in pink, a treat jar for the bribes it will take to keep the tutu on, and a trio of plush ghost toys for after the photos. Everything here is soft, washable and easy to put on a dog who has opinions. The harness and the treat jar stay in use all year, which makes the tutu basically free.

items.name: Pink ghost and pumpkin dog bandanas, 2 pack
Pink step-in dog harness and leash set
